newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu eases vs drachma, forex forwards, bonds hold.
newsitem.headline: Ecu eases vs drachma, forex forwards, bonds hold.

text.p: The ecu came off intraday highs against the drachma to trade around 310.10/20 in late trade after the central bank sold about 30 million ecus at the fixing, dealers said.
Forex forwards, depos and bonds were holding morning levels in subdued late trading activity.

"The drachma has firmed against the ecu in late trade," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "The central bank's move to sell about 30 million ecus for drachmas was perceived by the market as a signal that the ecu had risen too much lately."
Depos, forex forwards and bonds were idling in late dealings, traders said.
The finance ministry announced that it sold more than 350 billion drachmas of two-year zeros featuring a gross yiled of 9.9 percent today.
The mark was quoted at 159.03/13 from Friday's 159.270 fix, the dollar at 274.50/60 drachmas from 274.720 and the ecu at 310.11/21 from 310.400 drachmas.
